name: Guangzhou Human New Material Science and Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Human New Material Science and Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in research and development, manufacturing, and sales of functional resins and coating materials in China and internationally. The company offers water-based, optoelectronic, and solvent-free coating materials. It provides coatings and paints, including barrier, coil, metal packaging, transfer, and conformal coatings, as well as carbon coated slurry; synthetic polymers and resins, including polyurethane, acrylic, silicone, and polyester; adhesives and sealants comprising LED encapsulant, heat-seal adhesives for peel-off ends, and laminating adhesives; and other products.
